message.content:
Here’s a list of the long weekends (public holidays that fall on or create a three‑day weekend) in Canada for 2023.  
(If a holiday falls on a Friday or Monday, it creates a long weekend; if it falls on a weekend, it usually doesn’t create an extra day off unless the province observes a substitute day.)

| Date | Day | Holiday | Province(s) | Notes |
|------|-----|---------|-------------|-------|
| **January 1** | Sunday | New Year’s Day | All | No extra day off (holiday falls on weekend). |
| **January 2** | Monday | New Year’s Day (substitute) | Ontario | Substitute day because New Year’s Day fell on Sunday. |
| **February 20** | Monday | Family Day | Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario | Long weekend (Feb 18–20). |
| **March 20** | Monday | Good Friday | All | Long weekend (Mar 18–20). |
| **April 7** | Monday | Victoria Day | All | Long weekend (Apr 5–7). |
| **May 22** | Monday | National Indigenous Peoples Day | Northwest Territories, Nunavut, Yukon | Long weekend (May 20–22). |
| **June 19** | Monday | Canada Day | All | Long weekend (Jun 17–19). |
| **July 1** | Saturday | Canada Day | All | No extra day off (holiday falls on weekend). |
| **July 3** | Monday | Canada Day (substitute) | Ontario | Substitute day because Canada Day fell on Saturday. |
| **August 7** | Monday | Civic Holiday | Atlantic provinces (New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, Newfoundland & Labrador) | Long weekend (Aug 5–7). |
| **September 4** | Monday | Labour Day | All | Long weekend (Sep 2–4). |
| **October 9** | Monday | Thanksgiving | All | Long weekend (Oct 7–9). |
| **November 10** | Monday | Remembrance Day | All | Long weekend (Nov 8–10). |
| **December 25** | Monday | Christmas Day | All | Long weekend (Dec 23–25). |
| **December 26** | Tuesday | Boxing Day | All | No extra day off (holiday falls on Tuesday). |

### Summary of Long Weekend Dates (2023)

| Long Weekend | Dates | Holiday |
|--------------|-------|---------|
| New Year’s | Jan 1–3 | New Year’s Day (substitute on Jan 2 in Ontario) |
| Family Day | Feb 18–20 | Family Day (Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario) |
| Good Friday | Mar 18–20 | Good Friday |
| Victoria Day | Apr 5–7 | Victoria Day |
| National Indigenous Peoples Day | May 20–22 | National Indigenous Peoples Day (NT, NU, YT) |
| Canada Day | Jun 17–19 | Canada Day |
| Civic Holiday | Aug 5–7 | Civic Holiday (Atlantic provinces) |
| Labour Day | Sep 2–4 | Labour Day |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 7–9 | Thanksgiving |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 8–10 | Remembrance Day |
| Christmas | Dec 23–25 | Christmas Day |

These are the key dates you can use for your holiday‑planning app. If you need more detailed information (e.g., specific provincial holidays or substitute days for other provinces), let me know!
